mapper.sql: SELECT u.id AS uid, u.username AS username, u.role_code AS roleCode, u.status AS status, ui.nickname AS nickname, ui.avatar_url AS avatar, ui.sign AS sign, CASE WHEN IFNULL(ua.like_enabled, 1) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS likeEnabled, CASE WHEN IFNULL(ua.comment_enabled, 1) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS commentEnabled, CASE WHEN IFNULL(ua.im_message_send_enabled, 1) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS imMessageSendEnabled, CASE WHEN IFNULL(ua.video_upload_enabled, 1) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS videoUploadEnabled, CASE WHEN IFNULL(ua.profile_edit_enabled, 1) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS profileEditEnabled, CASE WHEN IFNULL(ua.like_enabled, 1) = 1 AND IFNULL(ua.comment_enabled, 1) = 1 AND IFNULL(ua.video_upload_enabled, 1) = 1 THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS videoBusinessBanned FROM t_user u LEFT JOIN t_user_info ui ON ui.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_user_access ua ON ua.user_id = u.id
